visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark, wavy hair poses playfully in front of a neutral, bright indoor wall. She wears a white spaghetti strap top and gold jewelry. Her facial expressions vary from smiling to pouting. (2) Close-up on hands pouring a clear, viscous liquid from a green AVEDA bottle. Then, the woman is shown in a shower setting with white foam lathered into her hair; she is seen from the back and side, wearing a tan strappy bikini top. (3) The woman holds a green-to-yellow gradient glass bottle with a dropper, squeezing a drop of oil onto her hand. She then rubs the oil through her damp hair while wearing a black spaghetti strap top. (4) She uses a white hairdryer to dry her hair, winking at the camera as the strands blow. Later, she uses a silver curling iron to create waves, shown in both medium and close-up shots. (5) Final sequence shows her with voluminous, shiny curls. She poses from different angles to showcase the hair's health. She holds up three yellow sample packets and a bottle of AVEDA oil, waves goodbye, and walks away carrying a large straw bag.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: Get Ready With Me Hair Edition. (2) [Slogan]: AVEDA 花植結構重鍵洗髮精 / 護髮乳. [Logo]: AVEDA. (3) [Slogan]: AVEDA 純香奇蹟光澤護髮露. (4) [Slogan]: TIPS 1 吹頭之前先抹一點光澤護髮露 撫平毛鱗片，頭髮不毛躁. (5) [Slogan]: TIPS 2 吹頭的時候由上往下吹 毛鱗片才不會亂翹. (6) [Variety]: 有光澤健康的頭髮～. (7) [Slogan]: 我捲髮的時候都是用捲髮棒的喔～. (8) [Slogan]: 捲髮器要與頭髮垂直. (9) [Slogan]: 捲完之後再抹一次光澤護髮露. (10) [Slogan]: 它吸收很好不會油油的. (11) [Slogan]: 很適合造型完使用. (12) [Variety]: 會讓頭髮閃亮亮的～. (13) [Slogan]: 現在活動網站可以索取「純香奇蹟光澤護髮露試用包」喔～. (14) [Slogan]: 隨身攜帶也好方便！.
